question: What is the correct order of radiations in descending order of frequencies?
solution:
The correct answer **X-rays > Infrared > Microwaves > Radio waves**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• Electromagnetic spectrum: It is the arrangement of electromagnetic radiations according to their frequency or wavelength.

 
 
• ​The electromagnetic spectrum has a range of frequencies, wavelengths, and photon energies.
 
• Typically, electromagnetic waves travel at the speed of light in a vacuum. 
 
• The electromagnetic spectrum is as follows: 
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfbdb867a01aeb6be4ff3f621565de71de7299c36e0e83d19507353563733de8.png] 

EXPLANATION__: 

 
• The increasing order of frequency of EM waves is given as Radio, Microwave, Infrared, Visible, Ultraviolet, X Rays, and Gamma Rays.
 
• From the above diagram, it is clear that the visible spectrum lies between the infrared spectrum and ultraviolet rays.
